value.message: Access Insights will help you gain confidence in your Role/ Group assignments. These are the stats curated specially for you based on a user’s peer and organizational level configurations.
Access Insights will help you gain confidence in your Role/ Group assignments
Analyzing the user to a group of users who are similar in some way. For example, user belonging to same Manager, Department, Cost Center, and so on.
These attributes will be used to consider peers of the user.
